summary: Full e2e testing of Kids IQ Test MVP. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed (auth, children CRUD, questions, assessment scoring + AI report via Claude, dashboard stats, cascade delete). Frontend: home page renders, theme toggle works, register/login flows work, protected routes redirect properly, child creation triggers auto-navigation to assessment, all 10 questions rendered, submit produces real AI report (Claude Sonnet 4.5), radar chart + skill breakdown + XP/stars/badges displayed, delete child cascades. One cosmetic testid discrepancy found on Home age cards (en-dash vs hyphen).

ui_bugs.issue: age-card data-testids use en-dash (U+2013) instead of hyphen. Actual testids: age-card-3–5, age-card-6–8, age-card-9–12, age-card-13–16. Review request expected ASCII hyphen (age-card-3-5, etc.). This will break any test script that uses hyphen. Backend uses ASCII hyphen for age_group values, causing inconsistency.

action_items: Fix Home.jsx AGE_GROUPS to use ASCII hyphen ("3-5", "6-8", "9-12", "13-16") so data-testids match the pattern age-card-3-5 as specified. The display labels can keep the en-dash separately if desired, but the value used in the testid should match the backend age_group string.
OPTIONAL: implement brute-force lockout (5 failed logins) per auth playbook — not currently in requirements but mentioned in playbook instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookies use secure=True, samesite='none' — correct for cross-site prod HTTPS setup. Works via requests + browser.
bcrypt.gensalt() produces $2b$ hashes — verified format is correct.
MongoDB _id properly excluded in all API responses via .pop('_id', None). Good.
AI report has a graceful fallback if LLM fails so assessment submission cannot break due to LLM errors — verified.
server.py is 451 lines — still within acceptable single-file range, but as more endpoints are added, consider splitting auth/children/assessment/dashboard into routers.
assessment_id lookup uses ObjectId(child_id) without try/except; a malformed id would throw a 500 rather than 400/404. Minor robustness issue.
delete_child endpoint returns {'ok': True} even when the child doesn't exist; consider returning 404 for missing resource so client can distinguish.
Dashboard.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete confirmation — works but a shadcn AlertDialog would be more consistent with the design system.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows pass; only cosmetic age-card testid discrepancy)

test_credentials: Seeded parent parent@test.com / Parent@12345 works. Admin admin@kidsiqtest.com / Admin@12345 seeded on startup. Registration accepts any unique email.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral children/assessments prefixed with TEST_ via new_user_session registrations; no manual seeding required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green with pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (uses xdist loadscope). E2E frontend UI flow verified through registration -> auto-redirect to create-child -> save child -> auto-navigate to assessment -> answer 10 questions -> report page with real Claude-generated AI report + radar chart. Delete child cascades to assessments. Only outstanding cosmetic issue: Home.jsx age cards use en-dash in testid ids.
rca_of_issues: Home.jsx defines AGE_GROUPS with range strings using en-dash character (U+2013) like "3–5". The testid is built via template string `age-card-${a.range}`, producing `age-card-3–5`. The backend consistently uses ASCII hyphen for age_group ("3-5"). Fix: change AGE_GROUPS range values to ASCII hyphen; optionally keep en-dash purely in display text.
